action: Scan through the area once more.
Instruct patient: 'Take a breath in and hold it again for me'.
Scan through the area to assess the kidney.
interpretation: Initial visual assessment of the kidney.

action: Instruct patient: 'And breathe away for me'.
Prepare to survey the kidney in transverse before capturing images.
interpretation: Plan to survey the anatomy prior to documentation.

action: Start the scan. Instruct patient: 'Just take another breath in here'.
Angle the probe up. Use the right lobe of the liver as an acoustic window.
interpretation: Utilize liver parenchyma to visualize the kidney.

action: Scan through the anatomy.
interpretation: Visualize the superior pole of the kidney coming through medially.

action: Maintain transverse probe orientation.
Focus on the hilum.
interpretation: Identify the renal pelvis and vessels coming out of the kidney.

action: Scan through to the lower pole. Continue scanning until completely out of the kidney.
interpretation: Ensure the scan covers the entire organ structure.

action: Instruct patient: 'Just breathe away'.
Survey past the organ borders.
interpretation: Look for exophytic lesions that could be missed if the scan does not extend fully out of the kidney.

action: Prepare to capture images. Start with longitudinal images.
Instruct patient: 'Can you take a big breath in and hold onto it for me now?'
Adjust knobology: Decrease sector width slightly.
Instruct patient: 'And breathe away'.
Instruct patient: 'And just take another breath in and hold onto it for me'.
Align probe to the middle of the kidney. Instruct patient: 'Breathe away for me'.
Check probe alignment to ensure no obliquing.
interpretation: Verify an even amount of parenchyma is visible all the way through the kidney.

action: Inspect the poles and medulla.
interpretation: Identify the medulla. Confirm parenchyma at the top is an even amount compared to the lower pole.

action: Confirm position.
interpretation: Verify alignment is right in the midline of the kidney.

action: Place calipers. Measure from the upper pole to the lower pole.
Read measurement.
interpretation: Kidney measures 104mm, which is within the normal range.

action: Label image 'right kidney long'. Capture image.
Move probe laterally to the lateral portion of the kidney. Instruct patient: 'Just take a breath in again for me'.
Start medial and sweep out laterally.
Isolate the lateral part. Instruct patient: 'Breathe away here'.
Observe the tissue structure.
interpretation: Note the loss of the medullary portion and visualization of only the cortex.

action: Instruct patient: 'And another breath in'.
Move probe medially to the final longitudinal position.
interpretation: Visualize the renal pelvis and vessels exiting and entering the kidney.

action: Capture image of the medial aspect.
interpretation: Show the rank of the kidney and the collecting system.

action: Prepare for transverse images. Scan methodically from top to bottom.
interpretation: Ensure representative images are taken across the full length.

action: Instruct patient: 'Can you just take another breath in and hold onto it for me?'
Start at the right lobe of the liver. Use the liver as a window.
interpretation: Visualize the parenchyma of the liver and upper pole of the right kidney with even echo texture.

action: Instruct patient: 'Breathe away'.
Move probe to an intercostal position. Angle down using the liver.
interpretation: Access the upper pole if subcostal view is insufficient.

action: Instruct patient: 'Just take a breath in again for me'.
Scan intercostally using the liver window. Instruct patient: 'Breathe away'.
interpretation: Capture beautiful image of the upper pole with nice, even echo texture.

action: Instruct patient: 'Again, another breath in for me and hold on to it'.
Scan inferiorly. Adjust depth.
Target the middle/medial part of the kidney. Capture image.
interpretation: Identify the medial part by noting vessels leaving the kidney.

action: Assess hypoechoic areas. Use Color Doppler.
interpretation: Differentiate between vessels and a dilated ureter.

action: Instruct patient: 'Take another breath in for me here'.
Apply Color box over the mid-portion vessels.
Observe area lacking color signal.
interpretation: Identify a small section of ureter (absence of color).

action: Change probe angle.
interpretation: Ensure good Doppler angle to confirm the structure is a ureter and not a vessel with poor flow.

action: Instruct patient: 'And another breather'.
Capture image of the transverse pelvis.
interpretation: Visualize blood vessels extending into the kidney itself.

action: Instruct patient: 'And just take another breath in for me'.
Deactivate Color Doppler. Scan down to the lower pole. Instruct patient: 'Breathe away'.
Redo image. Move focal zone higher. Instruct patient: 'Just take another breath in'.
interpretation: Correct focus position to improve resolution.

action: Increase depth. Verify focal zone placement. Instruct patient: 'Breathe away'.
interpretation: Visualize kidney clearly with optimized settings.

action: Instruct patient: 'Just one more breath in'. Survey through the kidney again.
interpretation: Confirm the kidney has been surveyed in its entirety.
